criteria.requirement: Open to applicants from all countries and regions worldwide, with no geographic restrictions.
criteria.applicant: Citizen and resident of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.quote: Geographic Eligibility: Open to applicants from all countries and regions worldwide. There are no geographic restrictions on eligibility.

criteria.requirement: Between 18 and 26 at the start of the programme (1 June 2027); the organiser makes no exceptions.
criteria.quote: Be between the ages of 18 – 26 at the start of the program (June 1, 2027).

criteria.requirement: Fluent written and spoken English; the application, resume and recommendation letters must be in English.
criteria.applicant: English is listed among the profile's languages, with no level and no test score.
criteria.missing: The applicant's level of written and spoken English.
criteria.quote: Be fluent in written and spoken English

criteria.requirement: Eligible for the visa and travel documents needed to attend the in-person programme in the United States.
criteria.missing: A valid passport and eligibility for a U.S. visa.
criteria.quote: Be eligible for appropriate visa and travel documentation

criteria.requirement: Identify a community issue in education, health or economic security and commit to the year-long programme (June 2027 to July 2028).
criteria.applicant: Interests are recorded (operations, business analysis, programme coordination, policy research); no community project is recorded.
criteria.missing: A community issue in education, health or economic security that the applicant would work on, and availability for the whole year.
criteria.quote: Identify an issue in their community in the areas of education, health, or economic security

criteria.requirement: No degree or education requirement is stated on the page.

funding.conditions: Economy class, arriving one day before and leaving one day after the programme; travel is no longer provided if a late visa application means the visa arrives less than a month before the programme.
funding.quote: International Economy Flights for international participants

funding.conditions: From the evening of 19 July to 29 July 2027 (New York University in New York, Champlain College in Burlington).
funding.quote: Housing from the evening of July 19 – July 29, 2027

funding.conditions: Three meals a day from 20 to 29 July 2027.
funding.quote: Three meals per day from July 20 – July 29, 2027

funding.conditions: Round trip between New York and Burlington, Vermont.
funding.quote: Round Trip Travel from New York, New York to Burlington, Vermont

funding.conditions: Public transport to and from JFK, LaGuardia and Newark airports.
funding.quote: Public Transportation to/from JFK, LaGuardia, and Newark Airports

funding.conditions: Passport fees, visa fees and in-country costs (travel to the airport, extra baggage fees) are listed as not covered by MCW.
funding.quote: Cost Not Covered by MCW Passport Fees Visa Fees

funding.conditions: Refundable deposit due from accepted participants by 16 March 2027, refunded in full in July 2027 after completing the in-person training; NYU's USD 50 cancellation fee is deducted if a requested room is not used.
funding.quote: The deposit will be refunded to the participant in full in July 2027, when they have successfully completed the in-person training program of the Fellowship.

funding.conditions: Under the liability release, any medical care during the in-person programme is at the participant's cost.
funding.quote: Agree that I am responsible for fees encountered for any cost associated with medical care

out_of_pocket: Passport and U.S. visa fees, travel to the departure airport, extra baggage and any medical care during the programme (amounts not stated), plus a USD 100 deposit that is refunded in July 2027 after the in-person training (less USD 50 if a requested NYU room is not used).

cycles.quote: Submit a completed application on or before Thursday, December 3, 2026, 11:59 PM (NYC EST time)
